name: Jerioth
title: Daughter of Caleb's Wife
summary: Jerioth is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles 2:18. She is associated with Caleb, son of Hezron, and is noted in connection with his wife Azubah. It is debated whether Jerioth was a daughter of Azubah or another wife of Caleb, but the text is unclear. She is one of many genealogical figures in the books of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Caleb's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jerioth is mentioned in connection with Caleb's genealogy in 1 Chronicles. She is linked to Caleb, son of Hezron, through his wife Azubah.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's Descendants
keyEvents.description: In the broader context of Caleb's descendants, Jerioth is listed alongside other family members as part of the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Genealogical Register of the Tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Jerioth is included in the extensive genealogical register for the tribe of Judah presented at the beginning of 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Hezron's Descendants
keyEvents.description: As part of Hezron's lineage, Jerioth is mentioned within a broader context of Israel's patriarchs and their families after settling in Canaan.
